A line-break-only emphasis nested inside an otherwise empty strong wrapper still separates the words on either side

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
